acceptance: On the first attempt, the Theseus review brief states that each listed binary needs one successful single-path `read`, and that a metadata-only result counts.
The brief and retry feedback no longer describe binaries as unread hunks; they name the read each binary needs.
Changed binaries stay required for protected paths, and the NUL-byte rule stays: no new exemption for executables.
A Theseus test covers a diff of only executables plus a checksum. Given the brief alone, a reviewer that follows it reaches complete coverage, and a trace with no binary reads is still rejected.

BenchBox's `.github/workflows/review-verdict.yml` is repinned to the Theseus release that contains the fix, and a bundled-binary rebuild PR (or a replay of the #4426 diff) gets a hosted verdict on its first round and passes `make pr-open`'s local review.
context:
Root cause from a read-only audit on 2026-11-21; its artifacts and a simulation are in /tmp/pr4426.
- The required set comes from evidence.py required_files. The binary exemption is font-only (FONT_EXTENSIONS) plus evidence.exempt_paths, which in BenchBox's .github/review.yml lists only README, CHANGELOG and docs/*.md.
- A binary is covered only by a successful single-path read of that exact path. Greps and multi-path reads don't count.
- Tests pin this on purpose: test_evidence.py:1262-1268 and :1300-1309.

Options considered and rejected:
- Exempt `_binaries/**` in review.yml. That covers only the top-level copies; the protected `benchbox/_binaries/` copies stay required, and a broad glob would also exempt the checksum hunks.
- Drop the `benchbox/_binaries/` soundness prefix. That removes deliberate protection added in #2468.
- Treat the diff's "Binary files differ" notice as covering the binary. That breaks the tests above and weakens the NUL-byte guard.

The fix belongs in Theseus (joeharris76/theseus): render.py brief wording, and coverage.py block_hints/_whole_hint on the first attempt. BenchBox then needs a version repin.

description:
Theseus (v0.2.17, 2ed4e0d) requires one successful single-path `read` of every changed binary that is not exempt. Only font files, or paths in `evidence.exempt_paths`, are exempt, and `soundness-paths.txt` protects `benchbox/_binaries/`. The brief lists these binaries under a header about changed hunks (render.py:298-316). Hints to read the whole file appear only on retries (cli.py:1645), and the retry feedback says "Read every changed hunk". Binaries have no hunks, so reviewers read the whole diff, return SHIP_WITH_FIXES and are still rejected as incomplete (coverage.py:302-307, evidence.py:531-548).

The impact on BenchBox PR #4426 (rebuilt TPC-DS dsdgen/dsqgen, 24 executables):
- All 10 hosted attempts on two heads were rejected; run 44916434667 had 5.
- The local review in `make pr-open` failed all 5 slots, so the PR description could not be refreshed.
- The PR only cleared when an hourly retry happened to read every binary.

The same thing will happen on every future bundled-binary rebuild (tpc-h or tpc-ds).
